## Delivery Budget

- Estimate confidence: medium

| ID | Work item | Effort | Architecture delta | Debt claim | Addresses | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| W1 | Versioned amendment records and canonical effective revision fold | 8 | 2 | - | - | Adds durable lineage and an execution-state abstraction over existing RecordStore streams, including historical recovery attribution and rebuild/compatibility tests. |
| W2 | Exact approval provenance and atomic registration command | 5 | 1 | - | - | Extends paired mutation/CAS across human, reviewer, Git and revision evidence; includes dry-run, duplicate and concurrent tests. |
| W3 | Reviewed impact assessment and effective finding continuity | 5 | 1 | - | - | Adds a plan-domain protocol contract and revision-aware finding/carry semantics across prompts and closure. |
| W4 | Revision-aware admission, contexts, gates and completion | 5 | 1 | - | - | Threads one effective state through execution boundaries without replacing history or resetting pre-author ranges. |
| W5 | Claim withdrawal and conservative evidence carry | 3 | 0 | - | - | Extends existing reconciliation/contract comparisons without another scoring model or authority. |
| W6 | State, upgrade transition, orchestration guidance and integrated acceptance | 5 | 0 | - | - | Publishes effective/history provenance, authoritative legacy discovery, command retirement and the complete workflow in all delegation variants, with installed-asset and end-to-end transition tests. |

Tests belong to their implementation item. No debt credit is claimed for this additional governance machinery.

### Surface Snapshot

- Subsystems: 6
- Production files: 30
- Persistent/external boundaries: 2
- New shared abstractions: 2
- New persistent schemas: 1

Subsystems are protocol, command/workflow integration, effective governance, budget/credit, record storage, and bundled assets. The two existing boundaries are RecordStore streams and Git evidence; there is no new external service. The production inventory below counts TypeScript modules plus bundled prompt/skill assets. The new abstractions are approved execution revision lineage and the reviewed impact/evidence disposition manifest. The persistent schema is one new versioned JSONL record kind, not a new SQLite table or migration. Reconcile these estimates during prerequisite verification; any new persistent projection or locking primitive requires plan revision.

findings.title: Define the mechanical scope of an authorize_amendment authorization and align --resolves with assessment references
findings.failure: An authorization for one Phase-3 finding could, through reviewer assessment alone, reopen completed earlier phases and withdraw credit without operator consent; the scope check is unimplementable as written, and cross-phase resolutions can never match the source-only --resolves selector.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: State that scope = binding, predecessor revision, source observation and findingRefs; --resolves must be a subset of those findingRefs (selector form aligned with the assessment); decide whether an earlier --from-phase or claim withdrawal needs additional typed operator consent; make authorizations single-use per predecessor revision; add a negative test for each out-of-scope effect.

findings.title: Add routing.ts and sqlite-index.ts to Files Touched and the surface count
findings.failure: Without these, either Decision 4 reassessment routing is implemented outside the inventory or an index rebuild projects gate IDs that diverge from live store derivation, contradicting the success contract that a rebuild yields the same readiness.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Add both modules to the Files Touched table with their changes, attribute them to W3/W4, and update the production-file count from 30 to 32.

baselineAssessment.reason: W1-W3 and W5 scores look reasonable; W4 (revision threading across admission, contexts, gates, decisions, corrections, routing, SQLite projection and completion) and W6 (archived-record upgrade discovery, all-delegation assets, two end-to-end lifecycles) each look closer to 8 than 5.

workItems.title: Versioned amendment records and canonical effective revision fold
workItems.rationale: Adds durable lineage and an execution-state abstraction over existing RecordStore streams, including historical recovery attribution and rebuild/compatibility tests. The fold keeps former-contract recovery decisions readable when they omit `amendmentScope`. Effort and architecture delta are unchanged; that compatibility rule is part of the existing fold.

workItems.title: Exact approval provenance and atomic registration command
workItems.rationale: Extends paired mutation/CAS across human, reviewer, Git and revision evidence, and validates registration against the structured `amendmentScope` intersection. Includes dry-run, identical-retry, reuse-rejection and out-of-scope tests. Effort and architecture delta are unchanged; the scope object refines the authorization contract already charged here.

workItems.title: Reviewed impact assessment and effective finding continuity
workItems.rationale: Adds a plan-domain protocol contract, phase-qualified resolution refs, and the `routing.ts` override that withholds the final-correction shortcut from a changed amendment assessment. Effort and architecture delta are unchanged; `routing.ts` is the concrete home for routing this item already required.

workItems.title: Revision-aware admission, contexts, gates and completion
workItems.rationale: Threads one effective state through execution boundaries without replacing history or resetting pre-author ranges, and projects the same revision-qualified gate identities from `sqlite-index.ts`. Effort and architecture delta are unchanged; the index module is the missing projection of gate work already charged here.

workItems.title: Claim withdrawal and conservative evidence carry
workItems.rationale: Extends existing reconciliation so a claim withdrawal, magnitude reduction, or contract edit is applied only when both `amendmentScope.claimEdits` and the assessment enumerate it. Effort and architecture delta are unchanged; no new scoring model or authority is added.

workItems.title: State, upgrade transition, orchestration guidance and integrated acceptance
workItems.rationale: Publishes effective/history provenance, authoritative legacy discovery, command retirement and the complete workflow in all delegation variants, with installed-asset and end-to-end transition tests. Skills tell the operator to record structured `amendmentScope` and not to treat rationale as scope. Effort and architecture delta are unchanged; that guidance is part of the workflow publication already charged here.
